title: GY-FAIR/2: relationships, four kinds, project record, reason-code register
authority: Owner approved the FAIR/2 draft on 2026-11-26 and asked that its blast radius be adapted when implemented.

scope.objective: Implement GY-FAIR/2 in goya-fair, keep FAIR/1 readable with unchanged canonical bytes, and move every consumer and document on this branch to FAIR/2.
exclusions: No FAIR-to-Goya reconstruction (still withheld by GY-ENT-001).
No inferred basis (DELECTABLE-0 owner decision 3 is open).
Other branches were not modified (see blast_radius.not_adapted).

blast_radius.method: Searched the working tree for goya-fair, goya_fair, GY-FAIR, FairDocument and FAIR/1, and checked every local and remote branch for crates/goya-fair and for crates that depend on it.

adapted.change: FAIR/2 schema, validation, upgrade(), canonical output; FAIR_CONTRACT is GY-FAIR/2, FAIR_1_CONTRACT added
new FAIR/2 fixture; example.fair.json kept unchanged as the FAIR/1 compatibility fixture

the only code consumer: v0.2.0 emits FAIR/2 (new kinds, relate.rs for relationships, entry points and framework detection; reads tracking), uses the shared register instead of its own list; tests, golden file and README updated
replaces fair-2-draft.md; records decisions made during implementation
new register; kept equal to the code by a test
Phase 0 row and Phase 1 progress name FAIR/2
entry rewritten as GY-FAIR/2, consumers listed
steps, DEG row and DEL-G02 updated

not_adapted.effect: A FAIR/1 reader there rejects a FAIR/2 document at validate with CONTRACT_MISMATCH; nothing drops data silently. Needs this change when nebula/v0.1 merges.

not_adapted.ref: arachnid/v0.1 and the nested arachnid/ checkout
not_adapted.effect: As for main. Not touched: it is a separate checkout on another branch.
Generated, not source. Left for their tools to refresh.

covers: FAIR/1 rules unchanged (12 original cases, adapted)
FAIR/1 fixture round-trips byte for byte under the FAIR/2 schema

unregistered codes refused under FAIR/2; register sorted, unique and equal to reason-codes.md
dangling, duplicate and self-citing relationships refused; derived relationships need evidence
project record checks (manifest membership, role, evidence)
canonical output sorts relationships, entry points, detections and evidence lists
golden FAIR/2 output for DEL-B01 (39 elements, all extracted; 30 relationships; 5 entry points; Electron 33.2.1 detected)

repository_evidence.lint: cargo clippy -p goya-disparate-electron -p goya-fair --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean

uni.drivers: traci telemetry rules, ferret unwrap findings in tests, viva-palestina excludes oxc_parser and oxc_allocator; a probe showed it excludes any crate named *_parser or *_allocator

honesty_notes: Relationships are as good as the joins behind them: literal channels, bridge keys, DOM IDs and binding names. reads and mutates inherit the extractor's lack of scope analysis.
No element on DEL-B01 is undetermined any more because FAIR/2 has kinds for them, not because more of the application is understood.
